query:
MATCH p=(u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
RETURN u.name AS User, a.artifacttype AS ArtifactType, a.category AS Category, c.name AS Computer, fo.profilepath AS ProfilePath, fo.profilepaths AS ProfilePaths, fo.findingid AS FindingId, fo.findingids AS FindingIds, fo.matchcount AS Matches
ORDER BY User, ArtifactType, Computer
name: Profilehound - Artifact Locations with Folder Detail
description: Lists collapsed artifact nodes with per-computer folder and finding evidence from FoundOn edges.
